{{Quote|You ever hear of Dersonn III? Or the Iti Cluster colonies?''"<br />"''Weren't they destroyed?''"<br />"''Right, that's because Hanharr happened.|Mira and the Jedi Exile|<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The '''Iti Cluster''' was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]]<ref name="KOTOR2" /> situated in the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At one point, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Hanharr]], who had previously been [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] himself and harbored a hatred for other living beings, particularly [[Human/Legends|Humans]], caused the destruction of the population of [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] in the cluster.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="3951 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Mira]] relayed Hanharr's involvement with the Iti Cluster to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], who had previously heard of the destruction of the astronomical object's population.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Iti Cluster was first mentioned in the [[2004]] [[Obsidian Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. In the game, the [[Star/Legends|star]] cluster can be mentioned in an optional conversation the player character, the Jedi Exile, can have with Mira after the former has made a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]]&ndash;aligned choice regarding the latter and Hanharr and after Mira has joined their crew as a result. This article assumes one hundred percent game completion&mdash;as well as that the player character makes only light side&ndash;aligned choices&mdash;and that the conversation took place as described.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the Iti Cluster in grid square T-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
